subject: maths
question: What is the value of (tan 10° tan 80° + tan 20° tan 70° + tan 30° tan 60° + tan 40° tan 50°)?
solution:
**Concept Used:**

tan θ = cot(90 - θ)

cot θ = 1/tan θ 

**Calculation:**

⇒ (tan 10° tan 80° + tan 20° tan 70° + tan 30° tan 60° + tan 40° tan 50°)

⇒ (tan 10° cot 10° + tan 20° cot 20° + tan 30° cot 30° + tan 40° cot 40°)

⇒ 1 + 1 + 1 + 1

⇒ 4

**∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.**
